{{About|the list of fish items|the activity|Fishing}}
'''Fish''' are the items caught by [[fishing]]. Matcha Flavoured has 47 of them: the four vanilla fish ([[cod]], [[salmon]], [[pufferfish]] and [[Tropical Fish|tropical fish]]) and 43 new ones. Each has a star rarity, is caught in one or two climates, cooks into a cooked fish and can be sold to the [[Fisherman]] for [[Obol]]s.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/gameplay/fishing}}</ref>

Every new fish is a vanilla cod, salmon or pufferfish item with its own name and texture, so it cooks like that fish: small fish into [[Cooked Fish|cooked fish]], large fish into [[Cooked Large Fish|cooked large fish]], and puffers into [[Cooked Pufferfish|cooked pufferfish]]. Raw fish heal nothing.
